name: MagicInterview
author: Sami Halawa
description: Know what to say next in interviews and meetings. Bring CV context and Notion notes. Live audio runs in the full app.

tools.name: magicinterview_get_profile
tools.title: MagicInterview profile
tools.description: Return the MagicInterview account represented by this connection. The opaque id stays stable across reconnects and token refreshes.

tools.name: magicinterview_open_workspace
tools.title: Open MagicInterview
tools.description: Open your MagicInterview workspace dashboard directly: recent conversations, the active conversation's latest lines and suggested answer, projects, sources, preferences and the latest debug events, all from this connected account's saved data. Live audio and voice practice open in the full app.

tools.name: magicinterview_prepare_meeting
tools.title: MagicInterview: Prepare a meeting or interview
tools.description: Save a meeting, interview, sales call or practice brief in MagicInterview with its title, notes and existing sources. Returns the saved conversation and app URL. Defaults to meeting preparation without changing the active conversation. Does not start audio, generate coaching or purchase access.

annotations.title: MagicInterview: Prepare a meeting or interview

tools.name: magicinterview_get_status
tools.title: MagicInterview: get status
tools.description: Read current MCP, database, account, and feature status with exact counts.

tools.name: magicinterview_research_project
tools.title: MagicInterview: research project
tools.description: Start or reuse the project's online research job. Its sourced notes are saved to the existing project context, replacing the earlier research source. Poll get_project_research for progress and the saved source.

tools.name: magicinterview_get_project_research
tools.title: MagicInterview: get project research
tools.description: Read this account's current project research progress, source, or failure without starting a job.

tools.name: magicinterview_list_projects
tools.title: MagicInterview: list projects
tools.description: List projects newest-first, including General, with search, purpose filtering, counts, and bounded pagination.

tools.name: magicinterview_get_project
tools.title: MagicInterview: get project
tools.description: Read a project, its shared notes, attached sources, and paginated conversations with valid app URLs.

tools.name: magicinterview_create_project
tools.title: MagicInterview: create project
tools.description: Create a project carrying shared purpose, company, role, notes, sources, and optional meeting provenance. Existing conversations may be moved into it; omitted sources use account defaults and an omitted language uses the account's default language.

language.description: Speech language of its conversations, e.g. es-ES; empty detects automatically.

tools.name: magicinterview_update_project
tools.title: MagicInterview: update project
tools.description: Update shared project metadata, notes, sources, or meeting provenance. Propagates changed inherited fields and source additions/removals, preserving conversation-specific fields, notes, and other sources.

tools.name: magicinterview_delete_project
tools.title: MagicInterview: delete project
tools.description: Delete a project folder and move its conversations to General, preserving their content and sources. General itself cannot be deleted.

tools.name: magicinterview_set_conversation_project
tools.title: MagicInterview: set conversation project
tools.description: Move one conversation into a project, or into General with projectId null. Preserves individual context and notes and adds the new project's sources; membership remains unique.

tools.name: magicinterview_set_project_context_attachment
tools.title: MagicInterview: set project context attachment
tools.description: Attach or detach one shared source on a project and propagate the change to its conversations while preserving unrelated individual sources.

tools.name: magicinterview_list_conversations
tools.title: MagicInterview: list conversations
tools.description: List conversations newest-first with project membership, optional project filtering, bounded pagination, and lightweight summaries.

tools.name: magicinterview_get_conversation
tools.title: MagicInterview: get conversation
tools.description: Retrieve one conversation, optionally including paginated turns, attached context bodies, coaching, draft, and continuation.

tools.name: magicinterview_create_conversation
tools.title: MagicInterview: create conversation
tools.description: Create a conversation in a project or General and optionally make it active. Inherits project metadata and sources with optional individual overrides; project notes stay shared. Never evicts existing conversations.

tools.name: magicinterview_update_conversation
tools.title: MagicInterview: update conversation
tools.description: Update conversation metadata, attached context IDs, language, draft, or continuation. Omitted fields remain unchanged.

tools.name: magicinterview_delete_conversation
tools.title: MagicInterview: delete conversation
tools.description: Delete one conversation. If it is the only conversation, replace it with a new empty conversation so the workspace remains valid.

tools.name: magicinterview_set_active_conversation
tools.title: MagicInterview: set active conversation
tools.description: Select the conversation MagicInterview opens and refreshes as active.

tools.name: magicinterview_append_turns
tools.title: MagicInterview: append turns
tools.description: Append up to 20 attributed turns to a conversation in order. IDs may be supplied for idempotent callers.

tools.name: magicinterview_update_turn
tools.title: MagicInterview: update turn
tools.description: Update one saved turn without changing its ID.

tools.name: magicinterview_delete_turns
tools.title: MagicInterview: delete turns
tools.description: Delete selected turns from one conversation.

tools.name: magicinterview_clear_conversation
tools.title: MagicInterview: clear conversation
tools.description: Clear all turns, coaching, draft, and live continuation from a conversation while preserving its setup and attached context.

tools.name: magicinterview_list_context_sources
tools.title: MagicInterview: list context sources
tools.description: List reusable context sources with optional search, type filtering, body inclusion, and pagination.

tools.name: magicinterview_get_context_source
tools.title: MagicInterview: get context source
tools.description: Retrieve one complete context source and its saved-original file metadata.

tools.name: magicinterview_create_context_source
tools.title: MagicInterview: create context source
tools.description: Create reusable context and optionally attach it to selected projects and their conversations, selected individual conversations, or every conversation as a default.

tools.name: magicinterview_update_context_source
tools.title: MagicInterview: update context source
tools.description: Update a reusable context source. Setting a CV/profile as default displaces the previous default CV/profile.

tools.name: magicinterview_delete_context_source
tools.title: MagicInterview: delete context source
tools.description: Delete one context source, detach it from every conversation, and delete its stored original files.

tools.name: magicinterview_set_context_attachment
tools.title: MagicInterview: set context attachment
tools.description: Attach or detach one reusable context source from one conversation.

tools.name: magicinterview_import_context_file
tools.title: MagicInterview: import context file
tools.description: Store an original context file from base64 plus its extracted text, preserving the same size, duplicate, revision, and account limits as the app upload flow.

tools.name: magicinterview_list_context_files
tools.title: MagicInterview: list context files
tools.description: List saved original files for one context source without returning binary content.

tools.name: magicinterview_get_context_file
tools.title: MagicInterview: get context file
tools.description: Retrieve saved original-file metadata and optionally its base64 content. Content is omitted by default to protect context size.

tools.name: magicinterview_get_preferences
tools.title: MagicInterview: get preferences
tools.description: Read account-level model, speech, appearance, microphone, and reading preferences.

tools.name: magicinterview_update_preferences
tools.title: MagicInterview: update preferences
tools.description: Update account-level preferences. Omitted fields remain unchanged.

defaultLanguage.description: The language new projects start in, e.g. es-ES; empty detects automatically.

tools.name: magicinterview_request_coaching
tools.title: MagicInterview: request coaching
tools.description: Use this when the user wants help answering an interview question, coding question, client objection or meeting turn now. Generates a response from the selected conversation and attached context. Saves the supplied turn and coaching answer unless save is false. Accepts user-supplied text as message (question, text and line are accepted as aliases); live audio capture runs in the full app. For a live call, prefer coach_line.

message.description: What was said or asked. Aliases: question, text, line.

tools.name: magicinterview_coach_line
tools.title: MagicInterview: coach line
tools.description: Live-call coaching in one call: give the line that was just said and who said it; MagicInterview appends it to the conversation as a turn (saveTurn, default true) and returns what to say next. Returns action (compose, refine, continue or hold), answer (the words to say; empty when action is hold), cue, latencyMs and the saved turn id. Uses the same coach, Pro check, model routing and guards as the live app. Loop it for every new line during a call; pass the returned turnId again to retry a failed call without duplicating the line.

text.description: The line that was just said. Aliases: message, question, line.

speaker.description: Who said it: interviewer (them) or candidate (the user).

saveTurn.description: Append the line and the answer to the saved conversation. Alias: save.

turnId.description: Idempotency key for the line; reuse it when retrying.

tools.name: magicinterview_get_debug_logs
tools.title: MagicInterview: get debug logs
tools.description: Retrieve persisted MagicInterview debug events newest-first. Pass conversationId for its MCP events and the bounded client snapshot captured by Copy debug log; use get_conversation for the complete transcript and coaching. Filter and paginate with nextBefore.

tools.name: magicinterview_get_conversation_url
tools.title: MagicInterview: get conversation url
tools.description: Return the current-domain URL that opens MagicInterview directly on one conversation.

tools.name: magicinterview_get_notion_sync
tools.title: MagicInterview: get notion sync
tools.description: Read this account's Notion connection and meeting-sync status, home URL, selected projects and last error.

tools.name: magicinterview_configure_notion_sync
tools.title: MagicInterview: configure notion sync
tools.description: Enable ongoing Notion sync under an authorized parent page. Select project IDs, or null for all. Creates stable Projects and Meetings databases. Notion owns Brief; MagicInterview owns transcript and coaching. Requires an existing Notion connection with insert/update permission.

tools.name: magicinterview_sync_notion_meetings
tools.title: MagicInterview: sync notion meetings
tools.description: Sync the configured projects now: pull editable Notion meeting briefs into attached context and update meeting details, transcripts and coaching in Notion. Preserves manual Notion notes.

tools.name: magicinterview_disable_notion_sync
tools.title: MagicInterview: disable notion sync
tools.description: Stop automatic Notion sync while preserving the Notion pages, meeting mappings and imported MagicInterview sources.

tools.name: magicinterview_import_notion_source
tools.title: MagicInterview: import notion source
tools.description: Import a shared Notion page as reusable context, or update its existing source. Optionally attach to an existing project or conversation.

tools.name: magicinterview_get_tool_catalog
tools.title: MagicInterview tool catalog
tools.description: Legacy catalog of MagicInterview operations by category, with exact names, descriptions, and read/write annotations. Every operation is also its own tool, magicinterview_<operation>, with its full input schema; call it directly.

tools.name: magicinterview_learn_tools
tools.title: Learn MagicInterview operations
tools.description: Legacy: retrieve descriptions, read/write annotations, and input schemas for a batch of exact MagicInterview operation names. The same schemas are the input schemas of the direct magicinterview_<operation> tools.

tools.name: magicinterview_read_tool
tools.title: Read MagicInterview data
tools.description: Legacy dispatcher: run one read-only MagicInterview operation by name with its schema-defined arguments. Accepts only operations annotated readOnlyHint: true and never changes workspace data. Prefer calling magicinterview_<operation> directly.

tools.name: magicinterview_execute_tool
tools.title: Change MagicInterview data
tools.description: Legacy dispatcher: run one MagicInterview write operation by name with its schema-defined arguments. Accepts only operations annotated readOnlyHint: false, including explicitly requested deletions. Prefer calling magicinterview_<operation> directly.

tools.name: magicinterview_app_read
tools.title: MagicInterview: Read workspace
tools.description: Read one schema-validated, account-scoped MagicInterview operation from the app.

tools.name: magicinterview_app_write
tools.title: MagicInterview: Save workspace changes
tools.description: Perform one schema-validated MagicInterview change requested in the app.
